scope: Saved declared fixed-square native ordered-cycle path only; no independent mechanics qualification

workpiece.cell_selection: native cell centre inside closed analytic shape; only original lower-half cells
workpiece.boundary_representation: native cell staircase; analytic circle is not a fitted boundary
workpiece.initial_gap_scope: nearest original mechanism node on matching horizontal/vertical native node lines; not contact onset
workpiece.kinematics: fixed rigid constraint overlay, all incident ux/uy remain undeformed
workpiece.material_role: Original arrays unchanged; fixed cell nodes imply interior F=I and Hu=0 without material evaluation

force_sign: medium/model on fixed lower-half body; negative holding reaction
mirror_convention: Lower (Fx,Fy), upper (Fx,-Fy), full net (2Fx,0); separate normal magnitude sum 2|Fy|
clearance_scope: Source node-window bounds; raster geometry diagnostic, not surface distance or contact proof

display.fixed_body_display: Saved native overlay cells; original material mask remains unchanged
display.displacement_color: Element mean of four actual nodal |lift+fluctuation| values [mm]; mechanism viridis / third medium Oranges; same range
display.body_arrow: Total medium/model force ON lower body, at lower-body centroid; no mirror factor
display.reaction_sampling: All attached support; remaining non-workpiece fixed nodes at stride 3

source_scope: Historical source capsule bytes checked; live source observations are informational only
mirrored_quantities: Only explicitly labelled cached mirror diagnostics; all model fields/actuator/support arrows remain lower-half quantities
